description: This file defines an abstract class 'MatrixCode' representing base functionality for 2D barcode codes within the PDFsharp library, including properties for encoding, dimensions, and image handling, as well as an abstract render method.

classes.name: MatrixCode
classes.description: Abstract base class for all 2D barcode types, managing properties such as encoding, dimensions, and image representation, and providing an abstract render method for subclasses.

methods.name: MatrixCode
methods.description: Constructor initializing the barcode with text, encoding, dimensions, and size.

methods.name: Encoding
methods.description: Property to get or set the encoding used in the barcode.

methods.name: Columns
methods.description: Property for the number of columns in the matrix code.

methods.name: Rows
methods.description: Property for the number of rows in the matrix code.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Property for the text content of the barcode.

methods.name: MatrixImage
methods.description: Internal property to get or set the image representing the matrix code.

methods.name: HasMatrixImage
methods.description: Boolean property indicating whether the matrix image has been generated.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Abstract method to render the 2D barcode using graphics context.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: Method to validate the text used for the barcode; implementation provided in derived classes.
